plains: Four equal 16:9 panels stacked in a 4:9 atlas: blue cloudy sky; distant low grassy hills on magenta; trees and rocks at extreme sides on magenta; grassy battle ground starting at 45% height on magenta. Early 2000s pixel art, no characters, text or UI, quiet battle center, matching palette, tileable sky and hills.
forest: Use case: stylized-concept. Production parallax layer atlas for a FOREST side-view RPG battle clearing. Early 2000s 16-bit pixel art, muted emerald canopy, teal distant trees, moss and warm soil, crisp pixels slight dithering. EXACTLY four equal horizontal 16:9 panels stacked vertically with NO borders or gaps, overall 4:9 ratio. Each is same viewport. Top panel: opaque hazy green forest atmosphere, very distant canopy, no foreground, fills panel. Second: solid pure magenta #FF00FF upper half, distant tree silhouette ridge fills lower half through bottom, no sky. Third: pure magenta background, detailed trunks foliage rocks ONLY at extreme left/right 15%, center 70% and bottom 35% pure magenta. Fourth: pure magenta upper 45%, mossy soil clearing ground from 45% to bottom; quiet low contrast earth in lower battle area, texture on edges, gentle elevated oblique perspective. Panels align to composite a natural open battle clearing. No text, no characters, no UI, no border, no shadows on magenta. Top two panels tile horizontally.
